proposals.evidence: Gen9 self-use showed a coherent Twin can become fail-closed immediately after a required benchmark rewrites Tier-1 evidence artifacts, even though source topology is unchanged.
proposals.expected_benefit: Create deterministic evidence epochs or snapshot transactions so compile/minimize/evaluate operate on one provenance-locked view, while newer evidence is queued for the next epoch rather than creating avoidable transient incoherence.
proposals.title: Evidence Epoch / Snapshot Freshness Coordinator

proposals.evidence: Early Gen9 self-use showed safety/recovery vocabulary can dominate the actual design intent; classification remains the first scope decision before evidence minimization.
proposals.expected_benefit: Improve deterministic intent precedence and add adversarial mixed-intent cases without learned/opaque routing.
proposals.title: Task Intent Classification Hardening

proposals.evidence: Gen9 used capsules safely for ablation and retained regressions; optimizer rules now provide concrete evidence candidates to mutate or withhold.
proposals.expected_benefit: Measure evaluator discrimination against bounded mutants and necessity counterexamples without risking accepted state.
proposals.title: Evaluator / Mutation Nursery on Experiment Capsules

proposals.evidence: Version-pinned Gen7 and Gen9 leave-one-out tests demonstrate value from replaying controlled evidence differences.
proposals.expected_benefit: Replay historical tasks with one evidence/version difference at a time and quantify whether a removed record was causally necessary.
proposals.title: Counterfactual Necessity Replay

proposals.evidence: Gen9 repeatedly removed registry/generation/object support that was semantically dominated by authoritative capability/memory evidence.
proposals.expected_benefit: Consolidate near-equivalent retained capabilities/memories only after evaluators, regressions, and necessity proofs preserve lineage.
proposals.title: Capability Consolidator with Necessity Proofs
